meta.name: product-marketing
meta.description: When the user wants to create or update their product marketing context document. Also use when the user mentions 'product context,' 'marketing context,' 'set up context,' 'positioning,' 'who is my target audience,' 'describe my product,' 'ICP,' 'ideal customer profile,' or wants to avoid repeating foundational information across marketing tasks. Use this at the start of any new project before using other marketing skills — it creates `.agents/product-marketing.md` that all other skills reference for product, audience, and positioning context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立产品营销背景档案，统一各营销任务的定位口径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写营销内容前都要反复交代产品背景
copy.tagline_en: Create a shared product marketing context doc for consistent messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of repeating product details in every marketing brief

howto.what: 装上后,它会先检查是否已有产品营销上下文文档;若没有,可选自动从代码库草拟或逐个提问,收集产品概览、目标受众、定位等 12 类信息,保存到 .agents/product-marketing.md,并维护版本号与变更日志。
howto.when: 当用户想创建或更新产品营销上下文文档,提及『product context』『positioning』『ICP』等关键词,开启新营销项目前,或想避免重复基础信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建产品营销上下文文档。
say.note: 会先查有没有旧文档,没有就从代码库草拟或向你提问。

say.text: 更新一下产品定位和客户语言部分。
say.note: 只收集相关部分的信息,保存时提升版本并加变更记录。

say.text: 现在我的产品营销上下文是什么样的?
say.note: 会读取现有文档并总结版本和最近的变更日志。

howto.what_en: Creates/updates a product marketing context file (`.agents/product-marketing.md`), gathering product, audience, and positioning info via codebase review or Q&A, and keeps a versioned changelog.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create/update product marketing context, mentions keywords like 'product context,' 'positioning,' or 'ICP,' or wants to avoid repeating basic info in a new project.

say_en.text: Set up my product marketing context.
say_en.note: Checks for existing doc, then drafts or asks questions.

say_en.text: Update the positioning and customer language sections.
say_en.note: Gathers those sections, bumps version, adds changelog.

say_en.text: What's in my product marketing context right now?
say_en.note: Reads the doc and summarizes version and recent changelog.
